plan.title: Asset PR to Split Auction Award and PO

steps.note: Enable split awarding required by the scenario.
Enable eRFX project creation from the PR.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.

args.title: Asset PR RFQ Auction Split Award

steps.note: Provide the mandatory event title.
Commit the 30-minute bidding schedule.
Invite the two vendors named in the case.
Publish the RFQ.
Confirm the RFQ reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's RFQ quote.
Verify Vendor A's RFQ quote was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's RFQ quote.
Verify Vendor B's RFQ quote was accepted.
Wait for the RFQ bidding window to close before conversion.
Convert the published RFQ, retaining its quotes and participants, into an auction.
Confirm the converted auction create screen opened without an error.
Publish the converted auction.
Confirm the auction reached a published project page.
Submit Vendor A's auction bid of 85.
Verify Vendor A's auction bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's auction bid of 88.
Verify Vendor B's auction bid was accepted.
Wait for the auction to close before reading QCS and awarding.
Open the comparison grid for the two auction bids.
Verify both real vendor columns are present.
Assert Vendor A is ranked first.
Verify Vendor A's bid rate is 85.
Verify Vendor B's bid rate is 88.
Enter the awarding screen after the auction has closed.
Allocate 6 units to Vendor A.
Allocate the remaining 4 units to Vendor B.
Verify the split allocation is complete and totals 6×85 + 4×88 = 862.
Create and submit the split award proposal from the awarding screen.
Confirm the award proposal was created and submitted.

args.remark: Approved for the asset PR split award.

steps.note: Approve the submitted proposal with the required remark.
Complete approval and create the purchase orders.
Verify POs were created for the two awarded vendor allocations.
Return to the events list to verify the final event state.
Open the History tab where the closed and awarded event should appear.
Verify this plan's event moved into History.
